variants.title: EQE and dark I-V of a perovskite solar cell
variants.sample: MAPbI3 perovskite cell, 500 nm absorber, band gap about 1.6 eV (SIMULATED)
variants.method: monochromator EQE 300-850 nm and dark forward I-V
variants.unknown: EQE spectrum, absorption edge, ideality factor
variants.note: A direct-gap absorber: a steep edge near 775 nm. The ideality factor near 1.7 points to trap-assisted recombination. Band gap from memory - verify; diode values illustrative.

source.title: M. A. Green, A. Ho-Baillie and H. J. Snaith, Nature Photonics 8, 506 (2014)

variants.title: EQE and dark I-V of a thin-film CdTe solar cell
variants.sample: CdS/CdTe thin-film cell, 3 um absorber, band gap about 1.5 eV (SIMULATED)
variants.method: monochromator EQE 300-900 nm and dark forward I-V
variants.unknown: EQE spectrum, absorption edge, ideality factor
variants.note: A direct gap near 1.5 eV cuts the EQE off near 830 nm; the CdS window would also cut the blue (not modelled). Band gap from memory - verify; diode values illustrative.

source.title: Schroder, ch. 9; CdTe band gap quoted from memory - verify
